name: io.github.petrkrulis2022/touchstone-mcp
description: Dated SIU, the benchmark price of AI inference work: one free tool, three paid via x402.

tools.name: get_index
tools.description: Returns the current signed Dated SIU print.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: SIU price and USD equivalent for one call of a task class against a model.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: SIU + USD equivalent for a specific token count against a model.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Reads an on-chain settlement and returns a signed attestation of quoted vs. paid.
